changesApplied: Revizuit diacriticele și naturalețea frazării în limba română.

verses.text: Dumnezeu spoke all these words, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Eu sunt the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu, who brought you out of the țară of Egipt, out of the house of bondage.
You shall have no other să pleceds before me.

You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu, am a jealous Dumnezeu, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not misuse the name of the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu, for the DOMNUL will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall labor six days, and do all your work, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

for in six days the DOMNUL made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the DOMNUL blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the țară which the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu gives you.
You shall not murder. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not commit adultery. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not steal. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They i-a zis lui Moise, Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let Dumnezeu speak with us, lest we die. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui the people, Don’t be afraid, for Dumnezeu has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The people stayed at a distance, and Moise came near to the thick darkness where Dumnezeu was. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall most certainly not make să pleceds of silver or să pleceds of să pleceld for yourselves to be alongside me.

You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not să plece up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

editorialNotes.resolutionReason: Preambulul Decalogului fixează identitatea Celui ce a eliberat poporul din robie.
Verbul ebraic ratzach se referă la omorul ilegal sau nejustificat.
